prompt:
Style references only: the attached images set the painting style, the colours and the mood. Do not copy their content. Paint it as a concept artist's painted sketch sheet for a cozy, bright strategy game: loose hand-painted brushwork with visible strokes, soft painted light from a warm sunny afternoon coming from the front right, cheerful bright colours, a warm light cream paper background with a soft painted shadow under each object. It is a painting, not a 3D render, not low poly, not a game screenshot. Cozy and friendly like a storybook toy, never grim. No people, no text, no labels, no numbers, no letters, no watermark.

The fourth attached image shows the three guns this game already has, small to large. The new gun belongs to their family: the same painting style, the same dark iron grey, the same chunky rivets and iron bands. Never copy those three guns.

The sheet shows three different designs for one new gun, side by side from left to right, each in a three-quarter view from slightly above, with empty cream paper between them. The new gun is a mortar: a squat, wide-mouthed iron mortar with a short fat barrel that points up at 45 degrees, held between two thick trunnion pins in a heavy iron bed, the bed standing on a round iron turning mount so the gun can swivel. It must read at a glance as a different gun from the long medium gun in the middle of the fourth image: short and fat against long and slim, pointing up at the sky against pointing ahead. Exactly one barrel. No wheels anywhere. No platform, slab or tile under it. Dark iron grey is the main colour, a little warm wood is allowed in the bed. Chunky simple shapes with few big parts, friendly and toy-like. Left: a classic fat pot mortar with a thick flared muzzle ring, sitting low between two heavy riveted iron cheek plates on a round riveted iron ring. Middle: a stubby mortar with two thick reinforcing bands, in a block-shaped oak bed strapped with iron, on a round iron turntable. Right: an early industrial mortar with a big rounded breech and a wide muzzle, in a riveted iron cradle with a toothed quadrant arc on its side, on a heavy round geared iron mount.
label: round 28 mortar
